Elements hidden via inline style="display:none" must not appear in the output

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<p>visible</p><div style="display:none">secret hidden text</div><p>also visible</p>')
puts result.content.inspect
```
